test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(**NOTE: **Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.

**E.g. 13- **Operations on 13 such as adding Isubtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(27, 21, 16)

(24, 33, 19)
solution:
The pattern followed in the given sets is:

 

**Multiple of 3 in the first term + Multiple of 3 in the second term = Third term**

Now we apply the pattern to the given sets:

(27, 21, 16)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b98b2da8dd6974a511e64900607e71a869191193de02f6f58de0b2e9ace2730.png] 

(24, 33, 19)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f56f7c41102ea760b7fa90c86c1e5c65154deb1bbb2a2a18366badb82079fdfe.png] 

Now we apply the pattern to the given options:

Option 1) (25, 21, 13)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/301eef665643ee2ab6759635fe32011e9957b26cbf1faadfbb9cfd3f4c8f75db.png] 

Option 2) (36, 15, 17)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de64bd107f34b14e27619deaa153587e1d0ebb0580d1febeb7570f1ecff085a5.png] 

Option 3) (42, 18, 21)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d6acdc40b4790ab5dfb539253193be42bd5597c8f840514dbe37d64b336aaed.png] 

Option 4) (32, 14, 7)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525bfe651ba7d5ce0f31d1b7257cd39379ae700ebbf252ec2ec0db2c2ab24d47.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**The pattern followed in the given sets is:

(First number + Second number)/3 = Third Number

Now we apply the pattern to the given sets:

(27, 21, 16)

(27+21)/3 = 16, which is the third number

(24, 33, 19)

(24+33)/3 = 19, which is the third number

Now we apply the pattern to the given options:

Option 1) (25, 21, 13)

(25+21)/3 = 46/3 

⇒ 15.33, which is not equal to the third number.

Option 2) (36, 15, 17)

(36+15)/3 = 17, which is the third number.

Option 3) (42, 18, 21)

(42+18)/3 = 20, which is not equal to the third number

Option 4) (32, 14, 7)

(32+14)/3 = 46/3 

⇒ 15.333, which is not equal to the third number.

**Hence,** the correct answer is "Option 2)".
